Personal accounts cannot share billing information with other accounts.

### Mistral AI Pricing (2026-11-26 to 2026-11-27)
- URL: https://mistral.ai/pricing
- Receipt: changes/mistral-pricing-2026-11-27.html
- Summary: On 2026-11-27, Mistral AI Pricing changed wording from "For most tasks and coding: Mistral Medium . For document AI: OCR. For audio and speech int" to "For most tasks and coding: Mistral Large 4 . For document AI: OCR 4.1 . For audio and spee".

```diff
--- a
+++ b
@@ -199,5 +199,5 @@
 Yes, Mistral's Free plan provides limited access to Vibe , including our latest models, chat, search, creation, and Vibe for code for agentic coding in your terminal. On the Free plan, you also get access to Mistral Studio .
 Which model should I use?
-For most tasks and coding: Mistral Medium . For document AI: OCR. For audio and speech intelligence: Voxtral . For cost-sensitive projects: Mistral Small . See the Models overview for more information.
+For most tasks and coding: Mistral Large 4 . For document AI: OCR 4.1 . For audio and speech intelligence: Voxtral . For cost-sensitive projects: Mistral Small . See the Models overview for more information.
 How is API pricing calculated?
 Most models are priced per million tokens, with both input (your prompts) and output (responses) counted separately. For example, Mistral Large costs $0.5 /M tokens in and $1.5 /M tokens out. Batch processing, for high-volume work, reduces the price by 50%, and cached input tokens reduce input cost by up to 90% for repeated prompts. A few APIs are priced differently: OCR is per 1,000 pages, speech models are per minute, and tool APIs are priced per call.
```

### Apify Pricing (2026-11-26 to 2026-11-27)
- URL: https://apify.com/pricing
- Receipt: changes/apify-pricing-2026-11-27.html
- Summary: On 2026-11-27, Apify Pricing changed wording from "For a full breakdown of both models, see Actors in Apify Store . If you need advice, pleas" to "For a full breakdown of both models, see Apify Store . If you need advice, please contact ".

```diff
--- a
+++ b
@@ -304,5 +304,5 @@
 Both models draw on the platform usage credits included in your plan, and excess usage is charged to your next invoice. Reading from or writing to a run's dataset after the run finishes also counts as platform usage.
 The exact platform usage depends on the specific Actor, the type of job it performs, how often it runs, and for how long. The easiest way to find out the platform usage of an Actor is to perform a test run. You can then review your platform usage in your Billing settings and figure out the best subscription plan for your needs.
-For a full breakdown of both models, see Actors in Apify Store . If you need advice, please contact us .
+For a full breakdown of both models, see Apify Store . If you need advice, please contact us .
 ### Can an AI agent pay for Actor runs without an Apify account?
 Yes. An autonomous agent with a crypto wallet can pay through the agentic payment protocols x402 and MPP , with no account and no human sign-up. The agent pays once at agi.apify.com , receives a temporary Apify API token with a fixed spend cap, and calls the Apify API with it like any other token. Each Actor run is metered against that prepaid balance, and unused balance expires with the token.
```

### Fly.io Pricing (2026-11-26 to 2026-11-26)
- URL: https://fly.io/docs/about/pricing/
- Receipt: changes/fly-pricing-2026-11-26.html
- Summary: On 2026-11-26, Fly.io Pricing removed: "Unsupported Products".

```diff
--- a
+++ b
@@ -164,7 +164,4 @@
 - IP addresses associated with the service
 You will be billed separately for data transfer to these external third-party services, including Tigris Object Storage. See our data transfer pricing for details.
-## Unsupported Products
-### Unmanaged Fly Postgres (Unsupported)
-Fly Postgres is a PostgreSQL database that you create and then manage yourself. Fly Postgres clusters are Fly Apps that consist of Machines, volumes, and any configured extra memory. The Machine price and volume price for Fly Postgres are the same as any other Machine and volume you'd run on Fly.io. Assuming the Machines are running all the time, the cost for the preset configurations is about $2/month for a single node cluster for dev projects and from about $82 to $164/month for a three-node production cluster. You don't need to keep the preset configurations, you can scale your Fly Postgres Machines to suit your workload at any time.
 ## Legacy plans
 On a legacy plan and wondering what that includes? Read more about Discontinued Plans .
```

- [Linear](linear.html) — 2025-04-15 to 2025-09-16. The pricing feature list adds Product Intelligence.
